dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate; trailing edge exhibits a deep, smooth concave spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small-radius rounded apex with a pronounced posterior-oriented hook-like projection.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear slope of approximately 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum visible basal width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small V-shaped notch on the lower third of the trailing edge; irregular light-toned epidermal patches on the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly sickle-shaped morphology with an unusually elongated and tapering posterior base.
